d: At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Inbound Marketer to build scalable inbound marketing systems that generate qualified pipeline through content, SEO, and conversion optimization.
This is far more than a traditional SEO role.

You’ll create high-quality content, improve search visibility, develop lead magnets, optimize conversion paths, and distribute content across the right channels to drive awareness, demand, and measurable business growth.
You’ll work closely with leadership and marketing teams to build inbound engines that turn content into qualified leads—not just traffic.
If you understand how search, content, buyer psychology, and conversion work together, and enjoy creating marketing assets that generate real business results, this role is a strong fit.
q: Excellent written English and storytelling skills.
Portfolio showcasing inbound or SEO-driven content.
Experience building and promoting lead magnets.
Experience improving website conversion rates and inbound lead generation.
What a Typical Day Looks Like
Write and optimize blogs, landing pages, and website content.
Research search trends, competitors, and keyword opportunities.
Build lead magnets and conversion-focused assets.
Review SEO and content performance data.
Optimize existing content based on rankings and analytics.
Collaborate with marketing teams on inbound campaigns.
Improve inbound funnels and content distribution strategies.
In short: You’ll build inbound marketing systems that turn valuable content, search visibility, and conversion optimization into qualified pipeline and measurable business growth.
Improved keyword rankings and search visibility.
Landing page and lead magnet conversion rates.
Engagement and performance of inbound content.
Consistent execution of high-quality inbound campaigns.
Direct ownership of inbound marketing strategy and execution.
Opportunity to build scalable content and demand generation systems.
Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities.

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience with inbound marketing, SEO, content creation, lead generation, and conversion optimization. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight campaigns you’ve worked on, how you’ve improved organic growth, and how you’ve used AI tools to enhance content creation, research, and marketing workflows. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the practical assessment and client interview.
You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.
Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

If you’re passionate about building inbound marketing systems, creating high-impact content, and turning search traffic into qualified pipeline, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive measurable business growth through modern inbound marketing.
r: Create high-quality, value-driven content that educates prospects and builds authority.
Develop content aligned with search intent, buyer journey stages, and conversion goals.
Continuously improve existing content based on rankings and performance data.
Collaborate on website and landing page optimization initiatives.
Improve conversion rates through stronger messaging and positioning.
Identify content gaps and inbound growth opportunities.
Develop compelling content ideas backed by research.
Optimize content based on measurable performance.
Provide recommendations that improve inbound marketing results.
Consistent growth in qualified inbound leads.
Higher organic search visibility and rankings.
Increased landing page and lead magnet conversion rates.
Strong contribution to pipeline from inbound channels.
Consistent delivery of high-quality inbound marketing initiatives.
What Makes You a Strong Fit
You understand that inbound marketing creates demand—not just content.
You write content that educates, engages, and converts.
You understand SEO, AI-powered search, and modern buyer behavior.
You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
You continuously improve performance using analytics and data.
You stay organized while managing multiple marketing initiatives.

d: We’re Hiring: Inbound Telesales Executive – Legal Services
Mohammad ALJASEM Legal Group | Kuwait | On-site

We are looking for an experienced telesales professional who can turn incoming client enquiries into signed legal service agreements through attentive follow-up, clear communication and effective objection handling.
You will manage the client journey from the first call to consultation attendance and contract completion, working closely with our legal consultants.
q: Fluency in spoken Kuwaiti Arabic is essential.
Previous telesales or inside sales experience involving direct responsibility for closing sales or service contracts.
Experience working towards and achieving individual monthly sales targets.
Strong objection-handling, persuasion and follow-up skills.
Excellent listening skills and the ability to manage sensitive conversations calmly.
Previous experience in legal or professional services is preferred.
r: Handle incoming calls and messages through the Group’s consultation line.
Understand clients’ needs, build trust and support anxious or upset callers with patience and professionalism.
Explain the Group’s services, consultation process and approved fees clearly.
Address client concerns and price objections, and follow up with undecided clients.
Coordinate with legal consultants and communicate their approved responses.
Book consultations, confirm attendance and follow up through to contract completion.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, follow-ups, appointments and signed contracts.
Meet individual monthly contract-conversion targets while maintaining client confidentiality.
x: The role includes client call handling and follow-up outside office hours, averaging 5–7 calls.
Monthly base salary: KWD 350, plus monthly incentives linked to eligible signed contracts.
Apply through LinkedIn and complete the screening questions. Your CV should clearly describe your previous sales responsibilities and results.

d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Sales Associate plays a crucial role in driving store sales and delivering excellent customer service. The position requires enthusiasm in greeting and assisting customers, maintaining store cleanliness and adherence to visual presentation standards. Success in this role is indicated by meeting sales targets, customer satisfaction, and contributing to a positive shopping environment. The Sales Associate works closely under the guidance of store management and supports them by executing operational duties efficiently.
q: Ability to maintain a clean and organized work environment.
What Qualifies You For The Role
1-2 years of retail sales experience preferred.
Physical ability to perform heavy lifting and stand for at least 8 hours.

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
r: Create a positive first impression for customers with an energetic attitude and adherence to dress code.
Greet customers immediately upon entering the store with a smile and sincere, non-business-like greeting.
Provide customers with current relevant information about the product.
Sincerely thank all customers for shopping as they exit the store and invite them back.
Create a sparkling clean and organized environment by maintaining store standards and cleanliness.
Provide quality service in the fitting rooms, follow up with customers in a timely manner, maintain cash wrap cleanliness, and attempt to add on to the sale.
Provide efficient service at the cash wrap, offer gift cards, maintain cash wrap cleanliness, and capture customer information in the database.
